verdict: A quiet day: a batch of Lightricks LTX-2 IC-LoRA tool releases for ComfyUI-style video-to-video work is the only real pipeline-relevant news, everything else is arXiv noise or non-production trade filler.

stories.headline: Lightricks publishes a set of LTX-2 IC-LoRA video-to-video tools: colorization, day-to-night, deblur, in/outpainting, detail refinement, cinemagraph
stories.body: Lightricks has released six IC-LoRA add-ons for its LTX-2.3/2.5-22b video models on Hugging Face, covering colorization, day-to-night relighting, deblur with character-consistency reference sheets, in/outpainting, detail refinement and upscaling, and cinemagraph-style selective motion. All are gated (require accepting licence terms), licence listed as "other" (not fully permissive), built on the 22b LTX-2 base. Download counts range from hundreds to nearly 19,000, suggesting active community use.
stories.why: These are near-production-ready video-to-video building blocks a studio could wire into a ComfyUI pipeline for restyle, relighting and cleanup.
